ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a solid contiguous band across the central axial region and trailing edges. The right lobe contains a high-contrast dendritic branching pattern of dark pixels. The left lobe displays more isolated, lower-density dark mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 115 degrees; vertex depth is partially obscured by waterline turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes between 5 and 15 pixels; edge profile is significantly jagged and non-linear across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering into sharp upward-curving distal tips; trailing edges follow a general concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of three dark, circular pixel groups located at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least five distinct, high-contrast linear dark streaks (rake marks) on the right lobe, oriented vertically and diagonally across the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks on the right lobe surface; extremely irregular and potentially notched trailing edge suggesting significant mechanical wear or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique tree-like (dendritic) pigmentation structure localized on the inner-to-mid section of the right lobe.
